title: LA Colossal – Black Najeon 05 (Seated)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Black woman in her mid-40s, short platinum pixie cut, natural face with a bold smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips filling the armchair, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body najeon-chilgi body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. Deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with iridescent mother-of-pearl tigers, pine trees, and magpies. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated in a carved wooden armchair, torso turned open toward the camera, one forearm on the armrest, the other hand on her thigh, legs crossed at the knee. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Towering 9-inch black lacquer platform stiletto d'Orsay pumps with pearl inlay.
Nails: Extra long coffin nails, black with pearl flakes.

Background & Lighting: MANDATORY seamless matte black studio background. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm key with strong raking side light and soft rim light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
